map.输入坝高、压缩模量、填筑容重、沉降系数与预测时间，按分层总和法与指数固结模型预测: Predict construction-period and post-completion settlement of a concrete-face rockfill dam by layer-wise summation and an exponential consolidation model, from dam height, modulus, unit weight and consolidation parameters.
map.施工期沉降（分层总和法）Sc = Σ[γ·z_i ÷ (E×1000)] × d: Construction-period settlement (layer-wise summation) Sc = Σ[γ·z_i ÷ (E×1000)] × dz, z_i = (i−0.5)·dz, dz = H/n; post-completion final settlement S∞ = α×10⁻³·H; settlement at time t St = S∞·(1 − e^(−c·t)); total settlement S = Sc + St; settlement rate = S ÷ H × 100%; stabilization time t_st = −ln(1−threshold ratio) ÷ c; slab deflection = St·β
map.面板堆石坝沉降分施工期与竣工后两部分：施工期按分层总和法，将坝体沿高度分为 n: CFRD settlement has two parts: construction-period and post-completion. Construction-period uses layer-wise summation, dividing the dam body into n layers along height; for each layer, vertical stress γ·z divided by compression modulus gives strain, multiplied by layer thickness and summed. Post-completion uses an exponential consolidation model where final settlement is proportional to dam height (coefficient α‰), and settlement at any time approaches via increment 1−e^(−ct). Total settlement rate is total settlement divided by dam height; post-completion and total settlement rates are usually kept within 0.5% and 1.0% respectively.
map.💡 施工期沉降 Sc=γH²/(2E×1000)；竣工后最终沉降 S∞=α×H；: 💡 Construction-period settlement Sc=γH²/(2E×1000); post-completion final settlement S∞=α×H; settlement at time t S(t)=S∞(1-e^(-ct)); stabilization time t_st=-ln(1-threshold)/c
map.压缩模量 E：优质堆石 100~200MPa，一般堆石 50~100MPa，软岩: Compression modulus E: high-quality rockfill 100~200MPa, ordinary rockfill 50~100MPa, soft rock 20~50MPa
map.竣工后沉降系数 α：优质堆石 1~2×10⁻³，一般 2~4×10⁻³，软岩 4: Post-completion settlement coefficient α: high-quality rockfill 1~2×10⁻³, ordinary 2~4×10⁻³, soft rock 4~8×10⁻³
map.固结衰减系数 c 反映沉降速率，一般 0.3~1.0/年，c 越大沉降收敛越快: Consolidation decay coefficient c reflects settlement rate, generally 0.3~1.0/year; larger c means faster settlement convergence
map.面板挠度系数 β 约 0.3~0.5，面板挠度约为竣工后沉降的 β 倍: Slab deflection coefficient β is about 0.3~0.5; slab deflection is about β times the post-completion settlement
map.竣工后沉降宜控制在坝高的 0.5% 以内，否则需改善填筑质量: Post-completion settlement should be kept within 0.5% of dam height; otherwise fill quality must be improved
map.分段数 n 越大分层总和法精度越高，默认 20 段: A larger number of layers n improves layer-wise summation accuracy; default 20 layers

map.面板堆石坝沉降预测工具基于分层总和法与指数固结模型，输入坝高、压缩模量、填筑容重: The CFRD settlement prediction tool is based on layer-wise summation and an exponential consolidation model. Input dam height, compression modulus, placement unit weight, settlement coefficient and prediction time to compute construction-period settlement (integrating vertical stress-strain by layer-wise summation), post-completion final settlement and settlement at any time (S(t)=S∞(1-e^(-ct))), total settlement rate, slab deflection and settlement stabilization time, and output a post-completion settlement process prediction table. It applies to settlement analysis and fill-quality evaluation of concrete-face rockfill dams (CFRD).
